target_customer: Academic and market researchers who need to run mobile studies without building software
problem: Researchers lacked an easy way to collect repeated survey data from participants on their smartphones.
product_category: Mobile data collection and research survey platform

founders.name: Brian Stewart
founders.background_notes: A University of Waterloo interview describes him as a graduate student in 2013 when introduced to Desouza.

founders.name: Charles Desouza
education: University of Waterloo, Systems Design Engineering (third year in 2013)
founders.background_notes: Source https://iwarrior.uwaterloo.ca/?p=30525 as shown in search results.

technical_complexity.rationale: Cross-platform mobile apps with scheduling, offline capture and a study builder; standard engineering with some hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Researchers embed study designs and data in the tool, but similar survey and experience sampling tools existed and the feature set was copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copy found; the company remains listed as active.

market_need_then: Researchers wanted participant responses on smartphones, as the company positioned itself for researchers without technical skills to build their own mobile surveys.

brand_strength.rationale: No press, community or brand material about the brand itself was found.

outcome_analysis: MetricWire stayed small after Summer 2014, a Kitchener research tools company that is still active with a handful of staff according to trackers. Public information on revenue, customers or funding beyond a small seed is missing, so it appears to be a modest niche software business rather than a venture-scale outcome.
notes: Company website metricwire.com returned HTTP 500 when fetched. Aggregators (CB Insights, Seedtable) list a single seed of about 120K dated December 2014 with Y Combinator and Communitech Rev; only aggregators so not recorded as a round and unverified. No dated competitor source was found for 2014, so the list is empty. Founding year is not stated by a source opened. Employee count is 3 on YC and 5 in a tracker.
